description: DRAFT (scripts/block-face/draft-type.ts (src/canalRecall/blockFace/typeDraft.ts)) for the review turn. Makassarpleinbuurt family 1925-1929, 5 storeys, 4.9-6.4 m wide: 35 pands on 4 block faces; median cornice 14.61 m, 2 window columns, wall #534b44. Pane layout, head kind, cornice kind, crowns and ground variants are NOT measured: see draft.unmeasured.
